summary: WebRender gained support for drawing and clipping along vector paths, including smoother anti-aliased edges and better hit testing, bringing more SVG shapes and CSS `clip-path` effects into its accelerated rendering. It also reworked backdrop filters—the effects that sample and blur or otherwise transform what is behind an element—to draw the needed background directly rather than copying it through extra intermediate steps. Other changes improve gradient color handling, iframe embedding policy checks, and rendering reliability in unusual or very large cases.
